orientation.note_en: Glade about 12 m across in true units (the set is built at x9 for tiny Alice). The great thistle stands in the centre; the raised bank of roots where the puppy looks down is on the north side; fallen sticks lie south-east of the thistle; Alice enters and runs off by the south gap. Sun from the west-south-west. Camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks.

landmarks.name: west oak
landmarks.name_en: the mossy oak on the west side

landmarks.name: east hazel
landmarks.name_en: the hazel stool on the east side

landmarks.name: south gap
landmarks.name_en: the gap in the south of the glade

views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot from the south gap across the glade of towering grass, the great thistle in the middle and the raised root bank behind it
low-angle medium shot from the thistle's foot looking steeply up at the root bank against the canopy where the puppy looks down
high oblique wide shot from the top of the root bank down across the glade to the great thistle and the grass round it
eye-level wide shot across the glade from the western oak, sun behind camera, to the hazel stool on the far side
eye-level medium shot from the hazel stool into the sun, backlit bracken fronds and foxgloves glowing green
low-angle close shot from among the fallen sticks up at the spiny thistle leaves curling overhead
eye-level close shot from the bracken toward the fallen sticks lying like logs in the leaf litter
eye-level medium shot from beside the thistle toward the south gap where the grass parts into the wood
low-angle detail shot of the purple thistle heads and silky down against the round halo of light in the canopy

checklist.note_en: Art Nouveau mosaic paving drawn on the woodland floor at the edges (card: no built ornament); west oak drawn as a sawn stump; hazel stems slightly oblique; kept for H2
